name: Mainspring Energy
desc:
Associate Operations Support Specialist II - Nightshift | $27.00 - $31.00/hr | Monitoring and System Alert Heavy, Minimal Phone overnights
https://jobs.lever.co/mainspringenergy/7429d314-f5f2-4c23-81ee-39561ce22b42

Company: Mainspring Energy
Position Title: Associate Operations Support Specialist II (Nightshift, Remote)  
 Industry: Technologies
 Realistic Job Overview and Responsibilities:
Mainspring Energy makes a clean power generation product called a Linear Generator, which is used by data centers, commercial facilities, EV charging stations, and utilities. This role monitors those deployed generators remotely overnight. When an alert fires, you follow a defined troubleshooting flowchart to resolve it, restart hardware if needed, or escalate to an engineer.
Key responsibilities from the posting:
Monitor system alerts and notifications during overnight shifts
Follow established troubleshooting protocols and flowcharts to address issues
Restart hardware systems or escalate to senior engineering staff when needed
Maintain detailed logs of all alerts and actions taken
Ensure issues are resolved within allotted timeframes or escalated appropriately
Provide flexible shift coverage for team absences and vacations as needed
Learn and understand electro-mechanical hardware systems over time
This is not a customer-facing role. There are no patients, no billing, and no call queues. Your primary interaction is with dashboards, alert systems, and internal engineering staff when escalation is needed. The work requires focus, reliability, and comfort working independently overnight with no direct supervision.
Shift options:
Block A: Saturday through Tuesday, 9:00 PM to 7:00 AM PST
Block B: Tuesday through Friday, 9:00 PM to 7:00 AM PST
Both are four 10-hour overnight shifts per week.

notes:
The pay range is the highest in the database for a non-licensed, no-degree-required remote role. $27 to $31/hr overnight with stock options at a pre-IPO company is genuinely compelling for the right participant. The tradeoff is the schedule. This is not a lifestyle fit for everyone and coaches should have a direct conversation about overnight availability before routing anyone here.
Employee reviews describe Mainspring as a place where the work is meaningful and there is always something new to learn, with management that is generally willing to work with employees. The culture appears to be mission-driven with a clean energy focus that appeals to participants who want their work to matter beyond a paycheck. Glassdoor
The pre-IPO stock options are worth explaining to participants. They represent potential future value if Mainspring goes public or is acquired, but they are not guaranteed income. Do not let participants factor them into their budget.
Confirm Oklahoma pay adjustment during the first recruiter contact. The posting states pay will reflect local market conditions, which typically means a reduction from the California-based range for Oklahoma residents.
Career Pathway: Operations Support Specialist II → Senior Operations Support Specialist → Operations Lead → Operations Manager → Director of Field Operations
